intent_record.intent_summary: Free the AC97 controller memory in the adapter release callback to prevent a memory leak.
intent_record.what: Added a kfree call for the ac97_ctrl structure in the ac97_adapter_release function.
intent_record.how: It releases the allocated memory for the AC97 controller when the adapter device is destroyed, preventing a memory leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a memory leak by freeing the ac97_controller structure on initialization failure.
intent_record.what: An else branch is added to the conditional block to call kfree(ac97_ctrl) when the initial condition is false.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that the allocated ac97_controller memory is properly freed instead of leaked when the registration setup condition fails.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory management on registration failure by directly returning the error pointer instead of manually freeing the controller structure.
intent_record.what: Replaced the error-handling goto statement with a direct return of the error pointer and removed the err label containing kfree(ac97_ctrl).
intent_record.how: Avoids manual deallocation of the ac97_ctrl structure upon failure of ac97_add_adapter, preventing potential double-free or lifetime issues.

candidates.rationale: The ac97_adapter_type struct lacks a .release callback, which is required to free the AC97 controller memory when the adapter device is released, leading to a memory leak.

commit 74426fbff66eea8e8d1f42c8238c268d1e63a832
Author: Robert Jarzmik <robert.jarzmik@free.fr>
Date:   Sat Sep 2 21:54:04 2017 +0200

    ALSA: ac97: add an ac97 bus
    
    AC97 is a bus for sound usage. It enables for a AC97 AC-Link to link one
    controller to 0 to 4 AC97 codecs.
    
    The goal of this new implementation is to implement a device/driver
    model for AC97, with an automatic scan of the bus and automatic
    discovery of AC97 codec devices.
    
    Signed-off-by: Robert
